EXPERIENCES WITH GENERAL CELLULAR AND NEURAL CELLULAR PATHOLOGY IN A CASE BASED BLENDED LEARNING ECOSYSTEM'S CBBLE"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;Hello,\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is N Vamshi krishna, a medical student from india.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI’ll be sharing few of my experiences in General medicine department.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBefore that I would like to thank my HOD sir and mentors who will be always available to clarify our doubts and help us to approach the patient in the most practical way. They taught us how to apply the theory knowledge in the clinical postings. They always gave us inspiration to learn the subject in more practical way. Also we had an open platform where we can discuss things with our HoD sir and our professors about patient and also we approach our HOD sir directly during our rounds, he will enlighten us without any judgement.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMedicine is a beautiful way of diagnosing and healing patient. I have always seen a patient as a mystery box yet to be solved and there clinical signs are like key to the diagnosis. I have learned to notice and observe the patient very keenly and it’s importance in diagnosis and exposure with patient has opened a new dimension within me in understanding medicine in practical way.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFIRST ENCOUNTERS:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMy first encounter in general medicine clinical postings.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAt first It was difficult for me to relate the theory knowledge to the practically approach. And for me I have low knowledge about how to approach the patient and in taking history deeply. But then with the help of our professors, mentors and my colleagues I had learnt a lot of things and also our general medicine department made it easy to learn for me by making online portfolios for learning and we were asked to get interacted with our SR’s, our own PG’s and mainly our HOD sir.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI was able to message at any time to HOD sir and our mentors, they was always there to guide and assist me without any hesitations.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn my journey I would like to share few experiences with you:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/nvamshikrishna107.blogspot.com\/2023\/04\/55-year-old-with-weakness-of-left-upper.html\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/nvamshikrishna107.blogspot.com\/2023\/04\/55-year-old-with-weakness-of-left-upper.html\u003C\/a\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;I had noticed a man of 55 years age, lying on bed with deviated mouth. I was curious to know the cause the cause. I went towards him, he was unable to speak clearly and his wife helped to know the history of the patient.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI would like share some Cheif complaints of this patient: weakness of left upper limb and lower limb since 3 days, C\/o deviation of mouth to right side since 3 days, C\/o slurring of speech since 3 days.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Epatient was normal around 4 days ago, then he started complaining tingling and burning sensation of left upper limb and lower limb for which he went to local doctor, where he was given some unknown medication and got relieved of his tingling sensation.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI was wondering what could be the reason for his tingling sensation.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn very next day(26\/3,Sunday) early in the morning he was unable to get up from his bed because of weakness in his left upper limb and lower limb ,he also noticed deviation of mouth towards right side and slurring of speech.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMy question was what will be the cause of deviated mouth:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBell’s palsy?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGillian barre syndrome? Neurologic\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENeuroma of facial?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERamsay hunt syndrome? Infective\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrauma?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECVA\/cerebral aneurysms? Vascular causes\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPast history:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/O CVA 3 years ago\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EK\/c\/o HTN since 3 years\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn clinical CNS examination:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETone hypertonic\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPower of left upper limb and lower is decreased i.e; 3\/5\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESuperficial plantar reflex on left side shows extension\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDeep tendon reflexes are deminished in left upper and lower limbs\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDysdianokinesia negative\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFinger nose test and knee heel test on left side negative\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EProvisional diagnosis: left upper limb and lower limb hemiparesis?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMy learning points:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ELMN and UMN lesions differences and how to differentiate -\u0026gt; Motor homenculus\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EStroke could be the cause?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECould HTN? Predisposing factor\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMedication to reduce blood clots?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAlso learnt CNS examination clinically in more precise way\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E"},"link":[{"rel":"replies","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/nvamshikrishna107.blogspot.com\/feeds\/1062216359038089357\/comments\/default","title":"Post Comments"},{"rel":"replies","type":"text/html","href":"https:\/\/nvamshikrishna107.blogspot.com\/2023\/06\/my-experiences-with-general-cellular.html#comment-form","title":"0 Comments"},{"rel":"edit","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/feeds\/7391325139276502517\/posts\/default\/1062216359038089357"},{"rel":"self","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/feeds\/7391325139276502517\/posts\/default\/1062216359038089357"},{"rel":"alternate","type":"text/html","href":"https:\/\/nvamshikrishna107.blogspot.com\/2023\/06\/my-experiences-with-general-cellular.html","title":"MY EXPERIENCES WITH GENERAL CELLULAR AND NEURAL CELLULAR PATHOLOGY IN A CASE BASED BLENDED LEARNING ECOSYSTEM'S CBBLE"}],"author":[{"name":{"$t":"N VAMSHI KRISHNA ROLL NO 107"},"uri":{"$t":"http:\/\/www.blogger.com\/profile\/13140526190857769623"},"email":{"$t":"noreply@blogger.com"},"gd$image":{"rel":"http://schemas.google.com/g/2005#thumbnail","width":"16","height":"16","src":"https:\/\/img1.blogblog.com\/img\/b16-rounded.gif"}}],"thr$total":{"$t":"0"}},{"id":{"$t":"tag:blogger.com,1999:blog-7391325139276502517.post-2615431146056313838"},"published":{"$t":"2023-04-04T05:30:00.004-07:00"},"updated":{"$t":"2023-04-24T22:42:07.780-07:00"},"title":{"type":"text","$t":"35 year old male, with loss of sensation of limbs"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003Cspan style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
